name: eval_benchmark_vlm_hallu
description: eval_benchmark_vlm_hallu is a dataset for evaluating hallucination behavior of vision–language models (VLMs). It measures whether VLM outputs contain unsupported or fabricated details when responding to visual inputs. The benchmark supports automated detection and scoring of hallucinations to compare VLM reliability.
reputation: A small, specialized dataset used by researchers studying VLM hallucinations; limited mainstream adoption.
